description: A resource manifest applied to an Airdress operator.

namespace.description: Accepted for k8s familiarity but ignored — every operator manages one airdress's resources (one namespace).

resourceVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token. When present, apply is rejected with 409 if the stored row's `resource_version` doesn't match. When absent, last-writer-wins.

spec.description: A hosted function served at /fn/<name>: either a signed WebAssembly component bundle the operator loads from its bundles directory, or signed TypeScript/JavaScript source the operator bundles and runs on its shared engine. Exactly one of bundle and source is present. The function's own manifest is the author's request; this block is the owner's grant, and a function asking for more than it is granted is refused rather than widened.

bundle.description: Which bundle to load, and the digest and signer to check it against. Used with runtime "wasm-component/v1"; mutually exclusive with source.

path.description: Bare filename of the .tar.zst bundle inside the operator's bundles directory. No directory separators and no parent references.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the compressed bundle file as 64 lowercase hex characters. When present the file must match it exactly.

signer.description: Ed25519 public key, 64 hex characters, that the bundle's detached signature must verify against. Required unless the operator explicitly allows unsigned local bundles.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the owner grants this function. The bundle's manifest may request a subset; requesting anything outside this block fails the load. Omitting the block grants nothing.

http.description: Outbound HTTP, limited to the listed hosts.

hosts.description: Hosts the function may reach: exact hostnames or alias keys from the operator's curated table. Wildcards are not accepted here.

maxResponseMib.description: Largest response body the function may read, in MiB. Default 8.

sign.description: Sign every request this function makes to an allowed host with this operator's HTTP-signing key (RFC 9421). Granted by the owner only: a bundle cannot ask for it. Default false.

signWith.description: Which signatures `sign` adds: `rfc9421` for operator-to-operator webhooks, `standard-webhooks-v1a` (Ed25519) for receivers that implement Standard Webhooks, or both. Omitted means rfc9421. Only meaningful with sign: true.

items.description: A signature scheme the host adds to each outbound request.

oneOf.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures, verified by a peer operator.
Standard Webhooks v1a: an Ed25519 signature over the webhook id, timestamp and body.

identity.description: Reading the function's own identity and producing scoped signatures.

inbox.description: Publishing events to the operator's inbox, limited to the listed topics.

topics.description: Topics the function may publish to.

kv.description: Key-value storage scoped to this function.

maxBytes.description: Total bytes the namespace may hold.

namespace.description: Namespace the function is confined to. Default: the function's own name.

llm.description: Model completions through the operator's configured providers.

models.description: Model identifiers the function may name.

providers.description: Provider identifiers the function may use.

log.description: Structured log lines into the operator's log.

config.description: Configuration the function reads at each invocation (airdress.config in JavaScript; the AIRDRESS_FUNCTION_CONFIG environment variable, a JSON object, for a bundle). Values are resolved when the function is called, not when it is applied, so rotating a secret takes effect on the next call with no re-sign and no re-publish. Nothing here is ever part of the signed source.

items.description: One configuration value: written inline, or drawn from a secret when the function is called. Set exactly one of value or valueFrom.

name.description: The key the function reads it under. Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit; unique within spec.config.

value.description: A literal JSON value. It is stored in the manifest in the clear, so never put a secret here. Set exactly one of value or valueFrom.

valueFrom.description: A value read from a secret each time the function is called; the function receives it as a string. Use this for credentials. Set exactly one of value or valueFrom.

secretRef.description: The name of a secret held by this operator.

enabled.description: Whether /fn/<name> is served. When false the bundle is still loaded and validated so a problem is reported, but no route is bound.

events.description: Which events this function receives. Every filter is evaluated by the operator before the function runs; an event that does not match is never an invocation, and a filter that errors or runs over its cost limit counts as no match.

filters.description: Filters over the event, each naming its dialect. All of them must match. An empty list receives every event from the source.

items.description: A filter over events. "structured" takes exactly one of exact, prefix, suffix, all, any and not, as the CloudEvents Subscriptions API defines them. "cesql" and "cel" take an expression.

all.description: All nested filters must match; at least one is required. Structured dialect.

any.description: At least one nested filter must match; at least one is required. Structured dialect.

dialect.description: The filter's dialect: "structured", "cesql" (CloudEvents SQL) or "cel" (Common Expression Language). A dialect this operator does not serve, or has switched off, is refused when the manifest is applied.

exact.description: Every named attribute must equal its value exactly (case sensitive). Structured dialect.

expression.description: The expression, for the cesql and cel dialects. Parsed and checked when the manifest is applied; one that does not parse is refused with its position.

not.description: The nested filter must not match. Structured dialect.

prefix.description: Every named attribute must start with its value (case sensitive). Structured dialect.

suffix.description: Every named attribute must end with its value (case sensitive). Structured dialect.

source.description: Where the events come from. "ingress" is the only source.

oneOf.description: Events arriving at this operator's ingress endpoints.

limits.description: Per-invocation limits. Each is clamped to the operator's own ceiling; omitting one keeps the operator default.

concurrency.description: Concurrent invocations admitted before callers queue. Default 8; the operator clamps to its own ceiling.

cpuDeadlineMs.description: Wall-clock budget per invocation, in milliseconds. Default 5000; the operator clamps to its own ceiling.

memoryMib.description: Linear memory ceiling per instance, in MiB. Default 128; the operator clamps to its own ceiling.

runtime.description: Runtime tier: "wasm-component/v1" for a bundle, "js-source/v1" for source. An operator without the source tier refuses "js-source/v1" by saying so, not by calling it malformed.

source.description: Which published source version to run, or which archive to import, and who must have signed it. Used with runtime "js-source/v1"; mutually exclusive with bundle.

import.description: Import a source archive from the operator's import directory (the fleet path). A function served from an import is read-only to the authoring API.

path.description: Bare filename of the .tar.zst source archive inside the operator's import directory. No directory separators and no parent references. Its detached signature is the file of the same name with .sig appended.

signer.description: Ed25519 public key, 64 hex characters, that the source's detached signature must verify against.

signerRef.description: An approved machine whose registered source-signing key must have signed the source. Revoking that key stops its future source without editing this manifest.

machine.description: The approved machine's name or id.

signers.description: Who may sign this function's source: a set of keys and approved machines, any one of which suffices — so an editor's key and a CI machine can both deploy the same function. Mutually exclusive with signer and signerRef. One to 16 members, each listed once (the operator refuses anything else by name). Changing the set is an apply by the owner; promote never changes it.

items.description: A signer: exactly one of key (an Ed25519 public key) and machine (an approved machine's name or id).

key.description: An Ed25519 public key, 64 hex characters.

machine.description: An approved machine, by name or id; any of its registered source-signing keys that is not revoked as compromised.

version.description: A published version in this operator's store, as sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters. Rolling back is applying the manifest with an earlier version.

tool.description: Declares this function to agents as a tool, served by the operator's tool bridge when that is enabled. Off unless enabled is true. A call is the same /fn/<name> invocation every other caller makes, authorized the same way.

annotations.description: Hints shown to callers. The operator relies on none of them: a retried call is deduplicated whatever idempotentHint says.

destructiveHint.description: The tool may change or delete something irreversibly.

idempotentHint.description: Calling the tool twice with the same arguments has no further effect.

openWorldHint.description: The tool talks to things outside the operator.

readOnlyHint.description: The tool does not change anything.

description.description: What the tool does, written for a model deciding whether to call it.

enabled.description: Whether the tool bridge lists and calls this function. Default false.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the arguments. Must be an object schema; it is checked to be a schema when applied, not when called.

name.description: The tool name agents see: letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, 1 to 64 characters. Defaults to the function's name.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the result, when the function answers with JSON.

title: Airdress operator Function manifest
